objective: Provide a local web console for observable Tunnel lifecycle, MCP communications and project activities
acceptance_criteria: Loopback web UI shows live readiness, last successful poll, communications and existing project receipts
Start and stop are scoped to the configured Tunnel and never expose or persist runtime credentials
Durable redacted diagnostics and modern localized theme UI are usable on desktop and compact widths
Current native Tunnel can be inspected without interrupting unrelated project work
